## Current Increment Assessment

The Classroom search and filters, CHG-04 (Simplify the CHG-03 button hierarchy), CHG-05 (Extend CHG-02 to participants), and ACT-02 (Test embedded-video configuration and define acceptable protection for the Option B application) increment has sufficient local evidence to continue. The approved Option B scope is not validated for launch acceptance because participant onboarding, authentication and participant-data governance, staging, operations, broader feature coverage, content readiness, and final authority evidence remain open.
